harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created LVM-backed volume vgdata/lvdata on node1 mounted at /srv/data, then grew it online from ~1.17GiB to ~2.34GiB while it remained mounted and its contents stayed intact (verified via sha256 checksums before/after). Since node1's disk (vda) was a single fully-used ext4 root with no spare block device, the PVs were built on loop devices backed by sparse files, with OpenRC persistence added so this survives reboot. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a boot_id baseline, triggered a native reboot, polled until node1 reconnected, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the LV auto-activated, remounted, and data was intact post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: single disk vda, whole-disk ext4 root, no spare block device for LVM
Installed lvm2 and e2fsprogs via apk
Created two 1200M sparse backing files, attached as /dev/loop0 and /dev/loop1
Created PV on loop0, VG vgdata, LV lvdata (100%FREE), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data
Wrote test data (50MB random file + text file) and recorded sha256 checksums
Added loop1 as second PV, ran vgextend + lvextend +100%FREE + resize2fs online (filesystem stayed mounted the whole time)
Verified LV grew to 2.34GiB (>2GB requirement) and checksums still matched after extend
Installed /etc/local.d/lvm-loop.start to reattach loop devices, vgchange -ay, and mount /srv/data on boot; enabled local and lvm OpenRC services in default runlevel
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline (mount, df, checksum)
Issued a backgrounded `reboot` so the exec acknowledgement returned before disconnection
Polled node1 with repeated execs until it accepted commands again
Verified changed boot_id, automatic LVM/loop reattachment, remount of /srv/data, and data integrity post-restart

evidence.requirement: Logical volume created and mounted at /srv/data
Data written before extend, to prove contents stay intact
evidence.summary: Created 50MB random file + text file under /srv/data, recorded sha256 checksums

evidence.requirement: Grown to at least 2GB while mounted
evidence.summary: vgextend with second loop PV + lvextend +100%FREE + online resize2fs while /srv/data remained mounted; resulting size 2.34GiB / 2.3G in df
sha256sum -c against pre-extend checksums reported OK for both files immediately after the extend
Captured boot_id 1ab99815-b081-41c0-83cf-6c79aa79934a plus mount, df, and checksum verification (OK) before reboot
Backgrounded `reboot` command acknowledged ('reboot scheduled') and returned before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart confirmed via connection loss then recovery
evidence.summary: Repeated poll attempts failed with connection reset/timeout while node1 was rebooting, showing the node was actually down

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 973eb56b-3857-4fbd-b320-205e5729ee2b differs from pre-restart 1ab99815-..., with uptime reset to 0 min

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of LVM, mount, and data
evidence.summary: After reboot: loop devices reattached, vgdata/lvdata auto-activated at 2.34GiB, /srv/data remounted, and sha256sum -c reported OK for both test files
